actions.action: Inspect leaf undersides and stems at night with a flashlight for caterpillars, beetles, snails or slugs
Check the soil surface for pests
Look for webbing, sticky residue, or cottony/scale-like bumps
Check whether pets have access to the plants
Check soil moisture with a finger 2 cm deep before watering and water only if dry
Make sure pots drain well and are not sitting in water
